subject.title: [Bug]: tools/sandbox: MEDIA_MAX_BYTES (5 MB) is hardcoded and not user-configurable

question: What media-store and sandbox-staging size-limit contract should OpenClaw support, including default value, hard maximum, and precedence with existing `agents.defaults.mediaMaxMb` and channel/account `mediaMaxMb` settings?
rationale: Source inspection proves the fixed 5 MiB cap still exists, but choosing the permanent config/default behavior changes sandbox and media resource boundaries and cannot be safely inferred from the current partial settings.

options.title: Define Bounded Shared Contract
options.body: Add or reuse a documented validated limit with secure defaults and a hard maximum, then wire every affected store, staging, gateway preflight, and reply-media path through the same resolved value.

options.title: Land Only Telegram Slice
options.body: Review the focused Telegram PR for immediate outbound document relief while keeping this issue open for the broader store and sandbox-staging contract.

options.title: Keep Fixed Core Cap
options.body: Reject core configurability for now and accept that larger sandboxed media remains unsupported outside per-path exceptions.

recommendation.title: Define Bounded Shared Contract
recommendation.body: Add or reuse a documented validated limit with secure defaults and a hard maximum, then wire every affected store, staging, gateway preflight, and reply-media path through the same resolved value.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses sandbox/media security boundaries where steipete has the clearest recent feature-history signal.
